items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.

Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller,

Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.

Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge.
Rags

Check discharge quantity 
 and pressure and record them.

Check the vibration level 
 of the pump set complete with the motor then, record them.

Check alignment and 
 record it.

Disconnect the coupling 
 between pump and motor.

Disconnect the suction, 
 discharge and auxiliary piping.

Dismount the pump from 
 the bedplate and place it on erection pads.

Disconnect the pump half 
 coupling.

Disconnect the bearing 
 housings.

Disconnect the stuffing 
 boxes.

Disconnect the casing 
 covers.

Remove the complete pump 
 rotor from the lower casing.

Dismount the shaft 
 sleeves from both side of the rotor.

Dismount the impeller 
 from the rotor.

During disassembly, 
 ensure that the individual parts are not damaged.

Check the validity of the 
 anti-friction ball bearings.

Check all parts for any 
 worn-out and replace them by new ones.

Inspect the run-out of 
 shafts (allowance 0.03 mm).

Check the run-out of the 
 rotor (must not exceed a value of 0.03mm during the measurement).

Assemble the impeller, 
 the shaft sleeves the gland follower with sealing rings and nuts.

Check the run-out of the 
 impeller sealing rings (must not exceed a value of 0.06mm) and the run-out of 
 the gland bushes must not exceed 0.03mm.

Assemble the bearings 
 with the inserted ring.

Fit the sealing rings 
 into the pump covers.

Lock the sealing rings by 
 locking set screw.

Secure the locking screws 
 against spontaneous screwing out by centers.

Mount the casing cover 
 from the side of the drive including the stuffing box and the intermediate 
 piece.

Put the assembled rotor 
 without bearings into the pump.

Mount the casing cover 
 from the opposite side of the drive including the stuffing box and the 
 intermediate piece.

Adjust the axial 
 clearance of the rotor (0.1-0.2mm) via the spacer rings of the bearings.

Assemble completely the 
 pump including the bearing from the drive side after adjusting the rotor in 
 the center position, then mount the spacing thrower ring on the side of the 
 angular contact bearing.

Cover the bearings and 
 mount the pump half coupling.

Lift the pump and put it 
 on its place, then adjust the alignment (be sure pump rotating freely by hand, 
 otherwise dismantle again and treat the causes).

Check the direction of 
 rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first time.

Check the quantity of 
 grease in the thrust-bearing sump.

Check whether the inlet 
 for flooding the stuffing box is open.

Check whether the inlet 
 for hydraulic sealing of the suspension is open.

Check whether the 
 delivery sluice valve is closed.

Open the delivery valve 
 gradually after the set has been started to operate at its full speed.

The temperature of the 
 anti-friction bearing in the bearing top which should not exceed 75C.

The temperature of 
 cooling water at discharge.
